meta.title: Household expectations
meta.question: Do Poles expect their household's situation to improve?
meta.measure: Average expectation for one's household's material situation in the coming year, from 0 (much worse) to 10 (much better)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on the household's material situation in the coming year, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: And over the next 12 months, do you expect that the financial situation of your household will get a lot better ... get a lot worse?
items.notes: CEEB 1-7 (Nov 1990 - Nov 1996), 7 surveys; asked of Poland in each (not in CEEB 8). Codebook: 'the financial situation of your household'.

items.wording: A year from now will you and your family live better (10), the same (5) or worse (0)?
items.notes: CBOS, Jan 1992 - Dec 2017, 306 surveys. Broader (how the family will live) than CBOS_HHEXP_MAT_5; asked alongside it from 2000. Excludes the 'in five years' and 'in ten years' variants of 1993. From 24 October 2026 coded in the collapsed form CBOS's reports print (no 'definitely'/'rather' split), in the microdata as in the reports of 2018-2026, so that the item is one series to 2026.

items.wording: Over the next 12 months your household's financial situation will definitely improve ... definitely worsen
items.notes: PGSW 1997-2023, 8 surveys. hhfin_fut_w2 (2005 wave II, same respondents) left out.

items.wording: In the coming year will your household's material conditions improve (10), stay the same (5) or get worse (0)?
items.notes: CBOS, Jan 2000 - Dec 2017, 200 surveys. From 24 October 2026 coded in the collapsed form CBOS's reports print (no 'definitely'/'rather' split), in the microdata as in the reports of 2018-2026, so that the item is one series to 2026.

items.wording: What are your expectations for the year to come: will it be better, worse or the same when it comes to the financial situation of your household?
items.notes: CCEB Jan 2000 (ZA3977, typo 'Expectaction'), Oct 2001, Sep 2002, Oct 2003, Feb 2004: 5 waves. Codes 1 same, 2 worse, 3 better.

items.wording: Your personal economic situation next year will improve, stay the same, get worse
items.notes: CDCEE March 2000 only (not asked in 1991); personal economic situation.

items.wording: Household's economic situation in the next 12 months: will deteriorate ... will improve
What are your expectations for the next twelve months: will they be better, worse or the same when it comes to the financial situation of your household?
items.notes: EB, Oct 2004 (ZA4229) - Mar 2026, 50 waves (incl. ZA4565, Sep 2007, zipped; ZA4975 Aug 2009 labels it 'EXPECTATIONS - FINANCIAL SITUATION', household in the Polish questionnaire). Turkish Cypriot copies as for EB_FINSIT_HH (first match is right).

items.wording: Over the next 12 months do you expect your personal economic situation to improve a lot ... worsen a lot?
items.notes: Pew spring 2013 only (in 2016 not asked of Poland); personal economic situation.

items.wording: A year from now will you and your family live better (10), the same (5) or worse (0)?
items.notes: CBOS's mixed-mode surveys (CAPI, CATI or CAWI, the respondent's choice) from APiW 359 (May-June 2020), so a question of its own.

items.wording: In the coming year will your household's material conditions improve (10), stay the same (5) or get worse (0)?
items.notes: CBOS's mixed-mode surveys (CAPI, CATI or CAWI, the respondent's choice) from APiW 359 (May-June 2020), so a question of its own.

items.wording: And a year from now the financial situation of your household will improve, not change, get worse
As CBOS_HHEXP_LIVE_5, in the CBOS democracy survey
As CBOS_HHEXP_MAT_5, in the CBOS democracy survey
items.notes: CBOS democracy survey (Apr 2021, mixed mode); label cut at 80 characters.

items.wording: Over the next year your household's finances will improve, rather improve, remain unchanged, rather worsen, worsen
In a year you and your family will live much better than now ... much worse than now
items.notes: PGSW 2025 only; same question as CBOS_HHEXP_LIVE_5.
